Client SBS model third-party notice

This non-root Artemis APK contains converted and optimized TFLite depth models in:

  client-sbs-dav2-models.tar.xz
  client-sbs-midas-models.tar.xz

Depth Anything V2 Small
-----------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2
Upstream model card: https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small
The upstream project designates the Small model as Apache-2.0. A verbatim copy
of that license is bundled beside this notice as LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt.

Artemis ships modified TFLite conversions, not verbatim upstream checkpoint
files. The shipped graphs use fixed rectangular input/output contracts,
guarded attention and GELU graph rewrites, and FP16 storage for selected
weights. The source distribution records hashes for the immediate Float32
TFLite inputs and final packaged entries. It does not currently record a
pinned upstream checkpoint revision and digest, exporter revision, dependency
lock, or exact original export command, so it does not claim a complete
upstream-checkpoint-to-TFLite reproduction chain.

MiDaS v2.1 Small
----------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/isl-org/MiDaS
The shipped conversions derive from the pinned Qualcomm AI Hub MiDaS-V2
Float32 graph whose release, download revision, and hashes are recorded in the
Artemis source distribution. MiDaS is licensed under the MIT License. A
verbatim copy, including its copyright notice, is bundled beside this notice
as LICENSE-MIDAS-MIT.txt.

Artemis modifies that graph with fixed rectangular input/output and decoder
resize contracts and FP16 storage for selected weights. The source model card
also attributes its EfficientNet-Lite3 encoder under Apache-2.0; the bundled
LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt supplies that license text as well.

LiteRT 2.1.6 native runtime and accelerator
-------------------------------------------
Upstream project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT
Upstream release: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/releases/tag/v2.1.6
The non-root APK ships the official LiteRT 2.1.6 Android libLiteRt.so runtime
and libLiteRtClGlAccelerator.so OpenCL/OpenGL accelerator for its packaged ABI.
The source distribution records the official download URLs and SHA-256 values
for both supported ABIs. These binaries are redistributed under Apache-2.0;
LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt is bundled beside this notice.
